usage: ‘姨媽’ is a noun used to refer to your elder maternal aunt, which means your mother’s older sister.
When talking about family members, 姨媽 is used to indicate a specific relative on your mother’s side.
You can use 姨媽 in both formal and informal conversations when mentioning your elder maternal aunt.
This word does not usually change form for singular or plural, so 姨媽 can mean one or multiple elder maternal aunts depending on context.
In Cantonese, 姨媽 can be used alone or with a possessive pronoun, like 我姨媽 (my elder maternal aunt).
